text: 上期所：《上海期货交易所实际控制关系账户管理办法》（修订案）经上海期货交易所理事会审议通过，并已报告中国证监会，现予以发布，自2026年10月20日起实施。
text_en: Shanghai Futures Exchange: The Administrative Measures for Accounts with Actual Control Relationships of the Shanghai Futures Exchange (Revised Draft) was reviewed and approved by the Board of Directors of the Shanghai Futures Exchange and has been reported to the China Securities Regulatory Commission. It is hereby issued and will take effect on October 20, 2026.
